complianceFlags.notes: No listing on the OMRI Products List (searched 2026-10-08: 'Caramba' and 'metconazole'; no Caramba product). Conventional DMI; label makes no organic statement.

notes: BASF FRAC 3 DMI (EPA label 2013-06-13). Barley, oats, rye, triticale and wheat: head blight (head scab) is suppression only at 13.5 to 17 fl oz per acre, applied at the beginning of anthesis; leaf diseases 10 to 14 fl oz per acre. At most 34 fl oz per acre per season and 2 Group 3 applications per season, 30 day PHI. The 30 day PHI is also the longest on the label, so it applies to every crop.
